newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Montepaschi reports 1996 profits up 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Montepaschi reports 1996 profits up 40 pct.

text.p: Italian bank Monte dei Paschi di Siena on Thursday reported that its net profit for 1996 rose 40 percent to 211.5 billion lire from 151.2 billion lire in 1995.

The bank's board is proposing a 1996 dividend of 250 lire per ordinary share and 500 lire per savings share, which will be put to shareholders at a meeting on April 30. The ordinary share dividend in 1995 was 150 lire.
The Siena-based bank said net interest income in 1996 fell some 3.8 percent to 2.333 trillion lire in 1996, while operating income rose 9.2 percent to 3.757 trillion lire.
Customer deposits at the bank rose 2.5 percent to 59 trillion lire, while customer loans increased 1.6 percent, although the bank did not give a figure.
